address: 141 boulevard de la Côte-de-Beauté, Vaux-sur-Mer, 17640, France
bio: In a small village near Royan, this contemporary eatery is the haunt of Frédéric Loivel. The chef is a craftsman with a creative bent, whose modern score highlights the seasons through intelligent associations and numerous nods to Japan (panko, yuzu, matcha, Kagoshima beef…). The interior tastefully blends mismatched decorative objects picked up here and there....
